newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on European sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on European sales.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended lower on Friday from New York's previous close on light selling from Europe in the afternoon, bullion dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$339.90/340.40 an ounce on Friday against New York's US$340.15/65 close on Thursday.
"There was light selling out of Europe which pushed the market down," said one bullion trader.
Gold remained stuck in its tight range with support at $339 and resistence at $341 per ounce, sources said.
The markets were quiet ahead of U.S. April empoyment data due later on Friday, dealers said.
Physical demand was quiet, particularly with China celebrating a three-day national holiday, sources said.
Local gold ended HK$2 higher at HK$3,149 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to +1.00 from its previous fix at -4.90.
